pick.name: OpenRouter
pick.what: One OpenAI-compatible key for hundreds of models, including 25+ free ones
pick.why: Widest model breadth with one key and easy swap; no prompt storage unless opted in
pick.free_limits: Free models: 20 req/min; 50 req/day (1,000/day after buying 10+ credits). 5.5% fee on credit purchases (Standard).

best_free.name: Groq (free plan)
best_free.what: Very fast inference of gpt-oss-120b/20b, Qwen3.8-27b, Whisper, Prompt Guard 2
best_free.why: Best free latency; also free Whisper + safety classifiers
best_free.free_limits: The published table is labelled as the Developer plan's base limits (gpt-oss-120b/20b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD; whisper-large-v3-turbo 20 RPM, 2K RPD; Prompt Guard 2 30 RPM, 14.4K RPD); Free-plan limits are lower or not published there. Data: Groq does not retain inference data by default; logs for abuse/troubleshooting kept up to 30 days; Zero Data Retention can be enabled by all customers.

alts.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
alts.what: Serverless open-model inference at the edge, callable from Workers or REST
alts.why: 10,000 free Neurons/day, good for embeddings/small LLM/Whisper next to a Workers-hosted app
alts.free_limits: 10,000 Neurons/day on Free and Paid; $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons above that (Paid only); resets 00:00 UTC; Kimi K2.6/2.7-code, GLM-5.x, DeepSeek V4 need Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits
alts.platforms: web (wrangler CLI on macOS, Windows, Linux)

alts.name: Vercel AI Gateway
alts.what: Aggregator with zero token markup, free tier subset of models
alts.why: TS-native with AI SDK; no markup incl. BYOK
alts.free_limits: Free tier = subset of models, per-model rate limits, monthly free credit (amount not on page); buying credits ends free credit; BYOK needs purchased credits

candidates.name: OpenRouter
candidates.verdict: Pick: breadth, one key; 5.5% credit fee

candidates.name: Groq
candidates.verdict: Best free latency + free Whisper; small daily caps

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
candidates.verdict: 10k Neurons/day free; best next to Workers apps

candidates.name: Vercel AI Gateway
candidates.verdict: Zero markup, TS-native; free credit amount unverified

candidates.name: Together AI / Fireworks
candidates.verdict: Strong paid open-model hosts; not evaluated for inference this pass

decision: OpenRouter wins on breadth for trying and swapping open models; Groq is the best free tier for latency and Whisper; Cloudflare Workers AI is the free fallback for embeddings and small models near Workers code. Free tiers are for non-sensitive data only; prefer paid plans or self-hosting for customer data.

verify.note: Confirmed: free models 20 req/min and 50/day, 1,000/day after $10+ credits bought; 5.5% fee (Standard), 8% (Business); 25+ free models.
